title: Floating Burgers in Neon Light
description: Two glowing Big Mac burgers float above a dirty tiled floor, connected by luminous, ethereal energy tendrils and light trails. A red McDonald's fries container and chicken nuggets sit on the right side of the grimy tiles, with VHS tapes visible on the left edge.
prompt: Surreal scene of two glowing Big Mac burgers floating above a dirty, grimy tiled floor, connected by bright luminous energy tendrils and light trails that flow through the air. A red McDonald's fries box and chicken nuggets sit on the right. VHS tapes are partially visible on the left. Dramatic cinematic lighting with strong highlights and deep shadows, moody and ethereal atmosphere.
